title: Rank Distribution in Quadratic-Twist Families
exact_target: Fix an elliptic curve $E$ over a global field $K$, a norm $\operatorname{Nm}$ on $K$, and $j\geq0$. If $\mathcal{F}(X)$ is the set of quadratic extensions $K(\sqrt{d})/K$ with squarefree $d$ and $\operatorname{Nm}(d)\leq X$, determine the limit as $X\to\infty$ of the proportion for which $\operatorname{rk}E(K(\sqrt{d}))-\operatorname{rk}E(K)=j$.
